value: You are Codewhale, an agent working alongside the user

notes: 0.10.1 (Rust binary fetched by the npm postinstall; no login): user-agent 'Mozilla/5.0 (compatible; codewhale/<version>; +https://github.com/codewhale-hq/CodeWhale)' on every route. The custom-provider 'wire' setting is ignored in this version (always chat completions); the Anthropic messages route comes from the first-party anthropic provider with a base_url override and sends no x-api-key over plain http, the Responses route from the first-party concentrate provider. The system prompt opens '## Codewhale' and splits into four system blocks at the <!-- cw:ctx:… --> markers on the messages route; 13 tools (execute_tools, tool_search, load_skill, create_goal…) identical on the first turn, after the tool call and on the --resume follow-up; every user message ends with a <turn_meta> block.
